Still item 1 only, still `Refs #36410 (item 1)`; item 2 (`NavigationOverlay` `comments` slot) stays on the card for the seat.

Seat route (repo:objectstack#3 seat thread, session `session_01WGufzi4PechTRCTBrfxV8W`, 2026-11-24T02:29Z), a route call, not a maintainer ruling: option A, in ux-C. The producer puts the comment in the link: plugin-audit's `collab.mention` and `collab.reply` inbox emits set `actionUrl` to `/{object}/{id}?comments={rootCommentId}` (a reply's root from `parent_id`; a mention on a reply uses its root; an optional second param may name the exact comment to scroll to). `openInboxNotification` just follows the link (no topic knowledge in the console). Desktop `RecordDetailView` gains a `?comments` URL entry that opens the comment panel at that thread and scrolls to the comment; phone's existing `?comments=` entry is reused. Inbox rows already stored keep the old link (no backfill).

File surface (replaces the claim's line): `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts` (the `collab.mention` / `collab.reply` emits and, at no extra cost, the e-mail `mentionUrl`) and its tests; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (desktop `?comments` entry, `openCommentsPage`), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/openInboxNotification.ts` only if it must change; the comment list scroll-to in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/**` comment components; their tests, changeset. ⛔ Not `@object-ui/components` `NavigationOverlay`, not `packages/spec/**`, not the messaging service's `actionUrlFor`. Stop and report on a breach.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus (TIER_DEFAULT; dispatch-gates --tier at 14f4d8f8 on plugin-audit audit-writers.ts + RecordDetailView.tsx: "no path-derived mandate")`, `effort: high` (server + console, two packages)
Clause-②: no — `actionUrl` keeps its string shape and its ADR-0030 "only pointer" role; adding a query param widens no accept set (confirmed by the seat route above).
Metadata-protocol: none — nothing an author writes changes.
